data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 洋馆月桂的黑色花嫁
data.description: 【久远寺宅月桂庭院·薄暮】有珠穿着端庄黑色婚纱坐在月桂树下，头纱边缘绣着细小的银色符文；她把捧花放在膝上，抬手让一只蓝鸟停在指尖，黑色眼眸向镜头递来克制的邀请。
data.action: 月桂树下坐姿承接蓝鸟，头纱银符微光，克制地向镜头发出邀请
data.lighting: quiet violet light and small silver rune glows
data.mood: 魔女不动声色的花嫁邀请
data.promptProse: Alice Kuonji sits beneath the mansion courtyard's laurel tree, bouquet on her lap as a bluebird settles on her raised fingertip. Her modest black wedding gown, white collar and silver-rune veil remain composed while dark eyes offer a restrained invitation. The vertical medium-full view includes branches and the quiet garden wall. Violet twilight softens the dress edge, while small silver rune glows illuminate nearby veil embroidery and the bird's lower feathers.
